candidates.statement: We believe, however, that the test of q-isospin will come from its extension to a q-deformed ﬂavor SU(3), where the large mass diﬀerence between the strange quark and the light q-isospin doublet allows for much cleaner computations (q should be rather diﬀerent from one) and the pion mass diﬀerence is of no great import.
At the very least, one should be able to come up with a q-deformed Gell-Mann–Okubo mass formula.
